scoring_justification: Checker recomputes phonon frequencies from the paper's EAM parameters (Table 1) using the standard EAM dynamical matrix, compares to agent's CSV via MAPE ≤5% monotonic decay.

hidden_assets.purpose: EAM potential parameters (spline knots, third-neighbor force constants) for Ni and Pd from Table 1 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 of the paper (Embedded atom method for phonon frequencies in transition metals, Solid State Commun. 75, 877, 1990).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values copied exactly from the published table; they are the fitted parameters used to produce the paper's phonon dispersion curves.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The numbers are directly transcribed from the paper's own reported parameter set. They constitute the underlying model that the agent must reconstruct; using them as gold tests whether the agent's implementation reproduces the paper's calculation.

outputs.description: Computed phonon frequencies. The hidden checker will calculate mean absolute percentage error against experimental reference data and score full credit if the error is ≤5%.

output_contract.notes: Only the phonon_frequencies.csv is scored; the fitting log is for evidence that the potential was fitted, not scored. The dispersion must include both Ni and Pd, all high-symmetry directions, all branches, and a dense q-point grid.
